Notoriety: Most Wanted.description:
🔥 You are among the most wanted people in the region: posters, a bounty, a task force.

⚠️ Pro teams hunt you actively; safehouses burn; allies weigh the reward.
🧊 Only a long stretch of lying low cools this.
Notoriety: Most Wanted.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is one of the most wanted people in the region: wanted posters and a reward, a police task force, and pro hero teams assigned to find them. Their face is on the news and on station screens; patrols double where they were last seen; safehouses and brokers they used are watched or raided; allies and contacts weigh the reward. Heroes who find them come prepared and in numbers. Only a long stretch of lying low, far from where they were seen, eases the hunt.
